item.title: Women’s Basketball Find Success in Historic Start
item.description: The Pepperdine Women's Basketball team got off to their best start in 45 years with a 9-3 record. As they look toward March, the Waves are carrying their wins and losses with them through the rest of season. The post Women’s Basketball Find Success in Historic Start appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Campus Recreation Keeps Community Active
item.description: Students, faculty and staff are finding new ways to stay active on campus. Between fitness classes and club sports, Campus Recreation has helped the community balance wellness and fitness. The post Campus Recreation Keeps Community Active appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Women’s Basketball Gets Revenge Against the Cougars
item.description: Pepperdine Women's Basketball beat the Washington State University Cougars 78-62 in a revenge game Feb. 7 at Firestone Fieldhouse. The Waves now extend the win streak to four games, their largest streak of the season. The post Women’s Basketball Gets Revenge Against the Cougars appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: Rant: Students Should Not Depend on Rate My Professors
item.description: Rate My Professors is a popular website for students to share grievances and compliments of their professors. Perspectives Staff Writer Alyssa Hunnicutt argues Rate My Professors harbors unreliable evaluations. The post Rant: Students Should Not Depend on Rate My Professors appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: ‘Hollywood’ in Malibu: RSFF17 Celebrates Student Films and Cinematic Dreams
item.description: From red carpet photos to heartfelt stories told on screen, this year’s ReelStories gave Pepperdine’s main campus a taste of Hollywood. The festival spotlighted student films and encouraged the dreams of aspiring actors and cinematographers. The post ‘Hollywood’ in Malibu: RSFF17 Celebrates Student Films and Cinematic Dreams appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.title: ‘no one is coming to save us’ Opens Conversations Around Climate Change
item.description: Pepperdine Theatre's latest production, "no one is coming to save us," which premiered last week, follows a young group of friends as they deal with the effects of climate change and wildfires. For the Malibu community, this isn’t just a story — it’s reality. The post ‘no one is coming to save us’ Opens Conversations Around Climate Change appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.description: Starting a new college class can feel like a gamble when you know nothing about the professor. item.description: SGA passed a new resolution, discussed the upcoming town hall, and addressed committees. SGA members said they are concerned about awareness and visibility. The post SGA Passes Resolution, Discusses New Committees appeared first on Pepperdine Graphic.

item.description: As seniors prepare to graduate, many describe their feelings on this new chapter as both intimidating and exciting. item.title: Trial Date Still Not Set for Fraser Michael Bohm
